United States Naval Command.

A faction cut off from the rest of their nation due to unfortante circumstance, the senior leadership decided to consolidated power into a new command council and continue the traditions of the USN as their own entity or if one day they can be reunited.

Elco Patrol Torpedo Boat.

This is a small craft armed with a decent armament of torpedoes used to take on bigger targets and then manuever away at speed.

Modified LCM-6.

This is a modified Landing Craft, uparmored and given a decent armament not really meant to fight ships head but fill more of a support/escort role.

TBD-1 Devastator.

This is an early war naval bomber, usually armed with torpedoes or other bombs mounted on it's underside.

TBF-1C Avenger.

This is an early to mid war naval bomber, usually armed with torpedoes or other bombs mounted on it's underside.

SBD-3 Dauntless.

This is an early to late war naval bomber, usually armed with torpedoes or other bombs mounted on it's underside.

F4F-3 Wildcat.

This is an early war naval fighter, sometimes armed with small bombs to deal with light targets.

Liberty Ship, Multi-purpose Ship.

This is an early to late war merchant ship, commissioned as part of a program to bolster supply line capability.

Victory Ship class, Multi-purpose Ship.

This is an early to late war merchant ship, this is an upgrade to the Liberty to improve it's engines and hull.

Cimarron class, Tanker.

This is an early to late war fuel tanker ship, commissioned as part of a program to bolster supply line capability.

Landing Ship, Tank class, Troop Transport.

This is an early to late war landing ship, usually used to support ground invasions or as very fragile light carriers.

Ironclad Monitor class, Monitor.

This is an ancient piece, most likely from a muesum but brought into service as a light gunship. There are some rumors of upgunning and automating the ship to better fit the role of a system patrol vessel.

Sampson class, Destroyer.

This is a pre-war torpedo destroyer, commissioned long ago but still in service due to it's decent torpedo count and relatively cheap cost.

Butler class, Destroyer Escort.

This is a late war destroyer escort, it was meant to act as a screen compliment to various size formations.

Balao class, Phase Destroyer.

This is an mid to late war phase submarine, it packs a decent punch with it's torpedoes but has little in terms of other armament as it's meant to hit and run.

Fletcher class, Destroyer.

This is a early to late war destroyer, it sports a decent armament making it good as a core all-rounder.

Atlanta class, Light Cruiser.

This is an early to late war light cruiser, it was originally designed with the intent to either lead destroyer groups or provide good screening capability to larger fleets.

Portland class, Heavy Cruiser.

This is a pre-war to later war heavy cruiser, it has a decent bit of armor and an upgrade to armament in comparison to the Atlanta.

Lexington class, Battlecruiser.

This is a pre-war battlecruiser, and is the only one of it's class in the USN's ship database.

Yorktown class Carrier.

This is a pre-war to late war carrier, it has a decent amount of aircraft and point defense with reserve craft beneth the deck inwhich elevators can be used to retrieve them.

North Carolina class, Battleship.

This is a early to late war battleship, it has a good amount of armament and point defense while also somewhat retaining a decent bit of manuervability.

Iowa class, Battleship.

This is a early to late war battleship, it has a good amount of armament and point defense while also somewhat retaining a decent bit of manuervability.
